articles.summary: Expanded integrations with Veeva Crossix and IQVIA Digital bring more granular healthcare insights closer to media decisioning The Trade Desk, a leading global advertising technology company, today announced expanded integrations with healthcare analytics and measurement providers Veeva Crossix and IQVIA Digital. The enhancements give pharma advertisers more granular insights into campaign performance and new ways to apply those insights to media optimization and decisioning. Pharma analytics has traditionally focused on evaluating campaign effectiveness and identifying optimization opportunities outside the platform environment. The Trade Desk is helping shrink the gap between insight and action by bringing more healthcare data, greater choice and more granular measurement and optimization closer to media decisioning, giving advertisers the ability to apply learnings and make optimizations while campaigns are still running. articles.title: The Trade Desk Expands Healthcare Measurement and Optimization Integrations for Pharma Advertisers
